# Drive Support files integration

Source: Google Drive folder `1kpdbjGngmma10Oy4V3BOH01nqnP8bXPz` (Fonts / Support / Support files).

- **Linetypes**: 58 from `TRIO.lin`
- **DWG blocks**: 242 (merged; 70 from Support/BLOCKS)
- **Text styles**: 199 (STYLE tables + Fonts folder)

## Bundled TrueType faces
Romans TT, Souvenir (4), Poppins (4), Roboto (4) + existing Liberation Serif/Sans/Mono.
SHX fonts are selectable as styles but render via these stand-ins.
